en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a posed family scene: a man in a suit is seated, with a woman in an ornate dress standing behind him, her arms resting on his shoulders. Two children, a boy and a girl dressed in early 20th-century clothing, interact with the adults; the boy holds a bouquet of flowers. The background features a large number '1' under a decorative bow. The style, attire, and photographic composition suggest an early 20th-century European setting. There is a logo in the lower left corner and a numeric code (3197/98) in the lower right. The words 'Biblioteca Regional de Madrid' are faintly visible at the bottom, suggesting Spanish origin.
